taskName: Distributed Saga Orchestrator with Dual-Write Mitigation
rawOutputSnippet:
### 1. Dual-Write Problem: Transactional Outbox Pattern

Services cannot commit to a local database and publish to a message broker atomically without 2PC. Solve this via the Transactional Outbox Pattern with Change Data Capture (CDC).

       │
       ▼ (Single ACID Transaction)
